definition.en: Energy transferred because of a temperature difference.
A quantity measured by a thermometer that tells how hot or cold something is.
definition.zh: 由温度计测量，表示物体冷热程度的量。

definition.en: An instrument that measures how hot or cold something is. It measures temperature, rather than heat.
definition.zh: 测量物体冷热程度的仪器，测的是温度，不是热量。

definition.en: Energy passing from a hotter place towards a colder place because of a temperature difference.
definition.zh: 因温差而使能量从较热处传向较冷处。

definition.en: A material that transfers heat easily compared with other materials under the same conditions. Metals are usually good conductors.
definition.zh: 相同条件下，比其他材料容易传热的材料。金属通常是热的良导体。

definition.en: A material that transfers heat slowly compared with other materials under the same conditions. Heat still passes through it.
definition.zh: 相同条件下，比其他材料传热慢的材料。热仍能通过它。

definition.en: The state in which bodies have the same temperature and no net heat transfer between them.
definition.zh: 物体温度相同，彼此之间没有净传热的状态。

definition.en: Slowing heat transfer into or out of an object. It supplies no energy and can help keep things warm or cold.
definition.zh: 减慢能量传入物体或从物体传出。隔热不供能，可以帮助保温或保冷。

definition.en: A graph showing how temperature changes with heating time. Here the points are calculated water temperatures.
definition.zh: 显示温度随加热时间变化的图。这里的各点是计算出的水温。

definition.en: A graph showing how temperature changes with cooling time. Here the surroundings stay at a fixed temperature.
definition.zh: 显示温度随冷却时间变化的图。这里的环境温度保持固定。

definition.en: How much matter an object contains. Use grams to set the water mass in this model.
definition.zh: 物体含有多少物质。这个模型用克设定水的质量。

definition.en: The rate at which energy is transferred. A heater of greater power supplies more energy in the same time.
definition.zh: 单位时间内传递能量的多少。功率较大的加热器在相同时间内供给更多能量。

definition.en: An increase in size. Under ordinary conditions, most substances expand when warmed if they have room to change size.
definition.zh: 尺寸增加。普通条件下，多数物质有空间自由伸缩时，受热会膨胀。

definition.en: A decrease in size. Under ordinary conditions, most substances contract when cooled if free to change size.
definition.zh: 尺寸减小。普通条件下，多数物质能够自由伸缩时，冷却会收缩。

definition.en: A comparison that changes one condition and keeps other relevant conditions the same.
definition.zh: 只改变一个条件，把其他相关条件保持相同的比较。

definition.en: The difference between two temperatures. In this cooling model, water changes temperature more slowly as it gets closer to the surrounding temperature.
definition.zh: 两个温度的差。在这个冷却模型中，水温越接近环境温度，变化越慢。
